{{For2|the plants known as "threefold"|Trixis|the chess term|threefold repetition}}

In [[algebraic geometry]], a '''3-fold''' or '''threefold''' is an [[algebraic variety]] of [[dimension of an algebraic variety|dimension]] 3.

The [[Mori program]] showed that 3-folds have minimal models.
